name: ContentBridge
description: Inject external content-source feeds into the Jellyfin media library as .strm virtual entries (NFO + poster), with scheduled sync, one-click search-and-add, and MaccCMS/Hailuo-style provide-vod API support. by 许诺 · 很庆幸曾经遇见你，遗憾的是只是遇见你——许诺
overview: Inject external content sources into your Jellyfin library

versions.changelog: Initial release: sync content-source feeds into the library as .strm virtual entries; config page with search-and-add; scheduled sync; movie + series layout.

Custom crawler feed standard (contentbridge-feed/1) with delta mode, deletion tombstones and per-item updated stamps; crawler development guide + runnable template; local stream proxy (UA/Referer, HLS playlist rewriting, Range passthrough); single build for Jellyfin 10.10.x and 10.11.x (targetAbi 10.10.0.0).

Plugin icon in the catalog and the installed plugins list; ContentBridge settings entry in the dashboard sidebar; auto-sync schedule (manual / hourly / 6h / 12h / daily / weekly) configurable from the plugin config page, shared with the sync scheduled task; developer name updated to Xunuo.
